label: TP
reason: User-supplied input flows directly into Base64 round-trip then into File constructor which is used as argument to File.exists(). The decoded content is printed via ESAPI encoder(), confirming reflection to HTML context. However, the actual filesystem access (File.exists()) uses the unencoded path derived from user input, enabling path traversal attacks.

evidence.note: User param undergoes harmless Base64 encode/decode cycle, then passed to File constructor and used in exists() call reflecting untrusted path
